_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with NVIDIA's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (NVDA listed 1999-01-22)

pit_profile.why: 'NVIDIA Corporation is the worldwide leader in programmable graphics processor technologies.' 'The market for GPUs, MCPs and handheld GPUs application processors is intensely competitive and is characterized by rapid technological change, evolving industry standards and declining average selling prices.' 'We expect substantial competition from Intel’s publicized focus on moving to selling platform solutions dominated by Intel products, such as when Intel achieved success with its Centrino platform solution.' 'Our business is cyclical in nature and an industry downturn could harm our financial results.' (FY2007 10-K); CYCLICAL on the 10-K's own words for its business (BKR's 'Our business is cyclical' reading); no theme in taxonomy_eras.json covers a CPU and a GPU integrated on one chip, so those words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -64.3%/yr (worst year FY99-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +29.0%/yr (Q3 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.0-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +66.0%/yr (FY99-FY07 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +294.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY99-FY07, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NVDA (retrospective, 2008-01-04) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.37x (94.2% downside to Bear $1.74 / +255.9% upside to Bull $106.77) | Adj composite 2.89 vs market 1.43: gap +1.46 [UNDERVALUED] | +86% above the EPP floor $16.10 (21x FY08E $0.77) | Conservative 2-yr case: +48.4% total (+24.2%/yr) | At 39.1x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $39.67 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +36.0% YoY in Q3 FY08, forward revenues +36% (Q3 FY08 revenue growth (no Q4 FY08 guide in numbers)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
